d:
Bharat-tibbat sima pulis (aaeetibipi) ke mahanideshak (diji) shatrujit kapur ne guruvar ko kaha tha, "pichhle kuchh dinon men aisi sthiti bani, jab arunachal pradesh men kaee jaghon par bharat aur chin aamne-samne aa gae. yah sthiti ab bhi jari hai." is sal julaee men uttar-purvi sima par tanav shuru hone ke bad yah pahli bar hai, jab aadhikarik taur par iski pushti huee hai. kangres ne ise lekar modi sarkar par nishana sadha hai.
BBC World Service ke nae aip ko daunlod karen.
BBC News hindi ko chunen aur paie nyuz alart, laiv tivi, podkast... sab ek jagah.
